group_structure: Subsidiary of the OMINVEST group via Jabreen Capital (OMINVEST's private equity arm). Ubhar Capital is the group's investment banking, brokerage and asset management platform; OMINVEST executives sit on its board. Holds an FSA investment banking licence since May 2024.

capabilities.wealth_summary: Ubhar Capital (U Capital) is an FSA-licensed Omani investment firm owned about 81% by OMINVEST's Jabreen Capital. It received an FSA investment banking licence in May 2024, which it describes as the first for an Omani private company. FSA-registered activities include brokerage, portfolio and investment management, custody, fund administration, margin financing, market making, marketing of non-Omani securities and issuing structured instruments. Asset Management runs discretionary equity and fixed income mandates for pension funds, sovereign funds, banks, central banks and HNW clients ('assets over USD 560m', undated) and three funds: Tarabut (Shariah balanced), The First Mazoon Fund (GCC/MENA equity and bonds; custodian National Bank of Oman) and Gheras Endowment Investment Fund (Shariah). Wealth Management offers RM-led access to global funds, international fixed income and bespoke solutions through external global managers, plus Indian markets via Kotak Mahindra Bank. Brokerage ranked top-3 on MSX by market share in 2015–2022 and offers online trading for Omani, GCC and US markets. It was Oman's first licensed market maker and liquidity provider (trained by Al Ramz), and is liquidity provider for Oman Arab Bank (2024) and Bank Muscat (2025).
